claims.statement: For every genuine Boolean f on disjoint uniform cubes X,Y whose nonzero Fourier coefficients have X-degree at most d>=1, the X-spectral marginal obeys H(p_X)<=2 I_Y(f)/ln2+2(d-1)-E_y Gamma_d(f_y), where Gamma_d is the exact nonnegative Boolean-granularity deficit. If every positive X-fiber has Fourier support at most K, then H(f)<=2 I_Y(f)/ln2+2(d-1)+log_2 K-E_y Gamma_d(f_y). If Var(f)>=nu>0 this implies the displayed dimension-independent FEI bound for fixed d,K,nu.
claims.quantifiers: All finite disjoint coordinate sets X,Y; independent uniform physical signs; all genuine Boolean f; integers d,K>=1 satisfying the stated degree and fiber-support hypotheses; real nu>0 when the variance consequence is invoked.
scope_exclusions: Not a proof of full FEI and not a Boolean counterfamily.
No universal bound on d, K, or the variance reserve is proved.
No universal decomposition into fiber-sparse pieces is proved.
The unrestricted conditional entropy H(S_Y|S_X) remains unpaid.
No correlated physical input law is allowed.
claims.tensor_guard: For F=f*g on a fresh block, fiber supports multiply by |supp(ghat)| and conditional entropies add. Fixed K excludes every positive-spectral-entropy arbitrary-core tensor sequence.
